quests.title: Welcome to GregGuns
quests.desc: Guns here follow GregTech progression: each weapon needs a machine tier and a gate material. This tab walks you up the tiers.

quests.title: Fire, Reload, Zoom
quests.desc: Hold use to fire, press the reload key to swap magazines, right-click to zoom. Rebind keys in Controls.

quests.title: Ammo and Magazines
quests.desc: Each gun takes one caliber. Loose rounds fill a magazine; sneak-click a magazine to empty it.

quests.title: Where Gear Comes From
quests.desc: Craft it in GT machines, or find it: quest loot bags, chests in ruins, drops from hostile soldiers. NEI lists every recipe and drop.

quests.title: Reading a Tier
quests.desc: An LV item needs an LV machine and steel, an MV item needs aluminum, and so on. Tooltips show the tier.
